title: 敦煌附近 ERA5 小时再分析气象，2025-06-01 至 2025-06-08 00:00 北京时间（七天＋端点）
nature: historical weather reanalysis and provider-derived tilted/instantaneous radiation; NOT station observations or measured wind/PV power
provider: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API; source ECMWF/Copernicus ERA5
spatial_resolution: ERA5 0.25 degrees, approximately25km; point API may apply provider terrain/downscaling processing
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, based on Copernicus Climate Change Service / ECMWF ERA5. Normalized timestamps/selected seven-day subset by this project. No endorsement implied.

preferred_integration.wind: wind_100m_ms; set example turbine wind_reference_height_m and hub_height_m both100m if model supports, rather than silently using90m
preferred_integration.solar: gti30_south_instant_wm2; provider-derived plane-of-array irradiance at30degree tilt and south azimuth0degree; configure example PV accordingly
preferred_integration.pressure: surface_pressure_hpa; optional density use must be explicit; not sea-level pressure
preferred_integration.time: time_s starts at Beijing midnight 2025-06-01; source instants. Use hourly zero-order hold [t_i,t_i+3600); this integration hold is a modeling assumption, not high-frequency measured weather. Endpoint at604800 closes seven days. Do not cycle silently or extrapolate after endpoint.

field_semantics.wind_10m_ms: Wind speed10m above ground, instantaneous at indicated hour, m/s
field_semantics.wind_100m_ms: Wind speed100m above ground, instantaneous at indicated hour, m/s
field_semantics.ghi_prev_hour_wm2: Global horizontal radiation, mean over preceding hour,W/m2; do NOT treat as start-of-hour instant
field_semantics.ghi_instant_wm2: Open-Meteo derived instantaneous GHI at source timestamp,W/m2
field_semantics.gti30_south_prev_hour_wm2: Open-Meteo derived tilted-plane radiation, mean over preceding hour,W/m2
field_semantics.gti30_south_instant_wm2: Open-Meteo derived instantaneous tilted radiation at source timestamp,W/m2; tilt30degrees,azimuth0south,isotropic sky,albedo0.20

limits: Hourly reanalysis cannot supply second/minute turbulence or rapid cloud ramps. Do not randomly jitter values to appear real.
Wind/PV electric output remains calculated by game device model, not a measured power time series.
GTI is radiation transposition by provider, not observed POA.
Use a visible accelerated replay to show hourly variation, without pretending one wall-clock second is one real weather second.
Do not mix prior-hour mean radiation with instant wind without explaining averaging conventions. Prefer paired instant fields for the existing instantaneous model.
